Using `on:introstart` to listen to the introstart event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onintrostart` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated

Using `on:outrostart` to listen to the outrostart event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onoutrostart` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated

Using `on:introend` to listen to the introend event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onintroend` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated

Using `on:outroend` to listen to the outroend event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onoutroend` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated

`visible` is updated, but is not declared with `$state(...)`. Changing its value will not correctly trigger updates
https://svelte.dev/e/non_reactive_update
